newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Yeung Kai-yin named to head Hong Kong's KCRC.
newsitem.headline: Yeung Kai-yin named to head Hong Kong's KCRC.

text.p: Yeung Kai-yin was appointed chairman and chief executive of the Kowloon-Canton Railway Corp (KCRC) for a three-year period with effect from December 24, the Hong Kong government announced on Wednesday.
Yeung was formerly executive director of Sino Land Co Ltd and is also a former civil servant, having served as Secretary for the Treasury and Secretary for Transport.
The current head of the government-owned KCRC, Kevin Hyde, gave notice earlier this year that he would not seek another term when his contract expires on December 23. He was appointed in 1990.
